evidence_policy: Only primary arXiv papers and PMLR author/proceedings pages are used; no social-media or secondary search summaries support claims; read_scope is bounded, not full-paper reproduction.
claim_status: Novelty distinctions are project inference, not proof of absence in all prior work.

sources.title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
sources.read_summary: Context compiler, frozen VLM tool selection, constrained execution and returned feedback. Small task series; self-history observations alone are not a general adaptation guarantee.
sources.project_boundary: agent context and harness are prior art

sources.title: Real-Time Execution of Action Chunking Flow Policies
sources.read_summary: Asynchronous diffusion/flow chunk inference uses committed prefixes and inpainting; evaluates dynamic Kinetix and real robot tasks under delay.
sources.project_boundary: chunk continuity and inference-delay robustness are prior art

sources.title: Training-Time Action Conditioning for Efficient Real-Time Chunking
sources.read_summary: Simulated inference delay and action-prefix conditioning during training reduce inference-time overhead; limitations include supported prefix/delay distribution.
sources.project_boundary: train-time prefix conditioning must be a comparator

sources.title: VLASH: Real-Time VLAs via Future-State-Aware Asynchronous Inference
sources.read_summary: Future execution-time robot state is estimated from committed actions; current image remains stale, and offset augmentation teaches state use.
sources.project_boundary: future-state correction is prior art; not an event-deadline contract proof

sources.title: Delay-Aware Diffusion Policy: Bridging the Observation–Execution Gap in Dynamic Tasks
sources.read_summary: Measured-delay conditioning and delay-compensated trajectories address dynamic observation-execution mismatch; corrected actions must still meet physical limits.
sources.project_boundary: delay conditioning and data compensation are prior art

sources.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
sources.read_summary: Conditions on observation capture and queried execution timestamps, uses time-aware RoPE or AddTime, and randomizes temporal sampling/schedules.
sources.project_boundary: explicit physical-time diffusion learning cannot be claimed new

sources.title: Time as a Control Dimension in Robot Learning
sources.read_summary: Remaining-time/time-ratio policy learning includes punctuality objectives, stability constraints, perturbation recovery and multi-agent coordination.
sources.project_boundary: task punctuality, deadline-conditioned RL and recovery are direct prior art

sources.title: TARC: Time-Adaptive Robotic Control
sources.read_summary: RL predicts control actions plus their duration under switch constraints; evaluates hardware and simulated VLA.
sources.project_boundary: variable application duration/control frequency differs from verified process-endpoint timing

sources.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
sources.read_summary: Fine-grained multimodal trace diagnosis, validated repairs, reusable skill library and search; task/debug/evaluation splits matter.
sources.project_boundary: validated agent repair/library and transfer are prior art

sources.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
sources.read_summary: Harness exposes reset, rollout, policy improvement and agent evolution; agents synthesize sensor-dependent verification/reward.
sources.project_boundary: physical closed-loop policy engineering is prior art; independently calibrate our endpoints

sources.title: RoboRSI: Stable, Efficient, and Reusable Robot Self-Evolution in Complex Real-World Environments
sources.read_summary: Task-skill contracts and scoped repair coordinate agents; successful executions also train compact ACT skills.
sources.project_boundary: agent skill contracts and execution-to-policy absorption are prior art

sources.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
read_scope: Appendix cross-task validation and held-out evaluation
sources.read_summary: Reconstructs simulation practice from datasets, uses privileged diagnosis, revises shared skills/prompts and retests cross-task changes.
sources.project_boundary: reconstruct-practice-transfer and cross-task regression gate are prior art; separate development privilege

sources.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
sources.read_summary: Aggregates expert action labels on learner-visited states and retrains under a no-regret reduction with stated assumptions.
sources.project_boundary: student-state relabeling is DAgger prior art

sources.title: Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Teacher
sources.read_summary: Flow teacher supplies student-visited action targets and an expert-likeness reward channel for coupled online exploration.
sources.project_boundary: on-policy robot distillation and reward/action dual signals are prior art

sources.title: Model-based Reinforcement Learning from Signal Temporal Logic Specifications
sources.read_summary: STL specifies robot behavior and model-based learning constructs finite-horizon model-predictive control to optimize specification satisfaction.
sources.project_boundary: logic-constrained learned control/MPC is prior art; our physical interval calibration is not a new STL theorem

sources.title: Learning from Demonstrations using Signal Temporal Logic
sources.read_summary: STL ranks demonstration quality and supplies non-Markovian rewards and sequential-task dependencies.
sources.project_boundary: temporal-logic demonstration scoring/selection and causal task dependencies are prior art
